title: PlayStation Plus October 2026 Games Include F1 25 and Hunt: Showdown 1896
summary: Sony has revealed the PlayStation Plus monthly games for October 2026, featuring F1 25, Hunt: Showdown 1896 and Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2.
content:
Sony has announced the PlayStation Plus monthly games for October 2026. The lineup features three different experiences, from competitive racing to tense extraction combat and cooperative action against giant enemies.

F1 25 brings official Formula 1 racing, career progression and online competition. Hunt: Showdown 1896 challenges players to track down monsters and rival hunters in a dangerous extraction shooter. Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 offers colorful voxel-style battles and cooperative gameplay.

According to the official PlayStation Blog, the games became available to PlayStation Plus members on October 6 and can be claimed until November 2, 2026. Availability may vary by region, so players should check their local PlayStation Store.
